en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway station building beside multiple train tracks. The large, rectangular two‑storey masonry structure has many tall windows and a hipped roof. A sign on the corner of the building reads "GULBENE". In the foreground are railway tracks, a water crane or signal installation, and lampposts. Trees line the background, and there is a low wooden fence along the side of the station. The handwritten word "Gulbene" appears at the top left of the postcard, and a small printed number and text appear in the bottom right corner.
